rows.name: EQUITY_UNKNOWN_SYMBOL
rows.user_action: 标的不存在——标黑并核对代码形态

rows.name: EQUITY_DO_NOT_HAVE_AN_ACCOUNT
rows.user_action: 账户未开通 Stocks 子户（Phase0-Q1 资格项）

rows.name: BSTOCKS_NOT_QUALIFIED
rows.user_action: 美股资格不合格——联系券商/换区，暂禁美股下单

rows.name: BSTOCKS_RESTRICTED
rows.user_action: bStocks 限制——美股通道降级，仅走现货

rows.name: REJECTED_MBX_KEY
rows.user_action: Key/IP/权限被拒（Enable Trading? IP 白名单?）——熔断该 broker

rows.name: API_KEY_FORMAT
rows.user_action: API Key 格式非法——人工核对

rows.name: ORDER_NOT_FOUND
rows.user_action: 查无此单——视为未受理，按查重结果决定重放

rows.name: CANCEL_REJECTED
rows.user_action: 撤单被拒（已成交/已撤）——状态由回报推进

rows.name: NEW_ORDER_REJECTED
rows.user_action: 柜台拒单（余额/风控）——占位行降级发送失败，查 msg 定位

rows.name: INVALID_LISTEN_KEY
rows.user_action: listenKey 过期已自动重取

rows.name: INVALID_SYMBOL
rows.user_action: 标的不存在/未上线——加入当轮观察黑名单

rows.name: BAD_PRECISION
rows.user_action: 价格/数量精度越界——核对 stepSize/tickSize 取整链

rows.name: MANDATORY_PARAM_EMPTY
rows.user_action: 请求缺必填参数——代码缺陷，报修

rows.name: INVALID_SIGNATURE
rows.user_action: API Secret 配置错误——熔断该 broker，人工核对密钥

rows.name: INVALID_TIMESTAMP
rows.user_action: 已自动校时重签；反复出现查系统时钟/NTP

rows.name: TOO_MANY_ORDERS
rows.user_action: 暂停新单窗口已开，稍后自动恢复

rows.name: FILTER_FAILURE
rows.user_action: 数量/金额/价格未过滤（LOT_SIZE/PRICE_FILTER/MIN_NOTIONAL）——核对 exchangeInfo 缓存与取整链

rows.name: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
rows.user_action: 限速器已退避；持续出现请下调下单频率

rows.name: UNKNOWN_EXCHANGE_ERROR
rows.user_action: 查 order/query 确认受理状态后人工决定重放

rows.name: EQUITY_ORDER_ID_OR_CLORD_REQUIRED
rows.user_action: 查询缺 orderId/clientOrderId——代码缺陷，报修

rows.name: EQUITY_ORDER_NOT_FOUND
rows.user_action: 查无此单——按未受理处理

rows.name: EQUITY_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE
rows.user_action: 余额不足——拒单（不可自动重试）

rows.name: EQUITY_SYMBOL_NO_ODD_LOT
rows.user_action: 该票不支持碎股——改整股数量重下

rows.name: EQUITY_PREMARKET_NO_ODD_LOT
rows.user_action: 盘前不支持碎股——转 RTH 或整股

rows.name: EQUITY_DISCLAIMER_UNSIGNED
rows.user_action: 美股风险披露未签——/api/binance/disclaimer 签署后恢复

rows.name: EQUITY_QTY_BELOW_MIN
rows.user_action: 数量低于最小——前置闸应已拦

rows.name: EQUITY_QTY_ABOVE_MAX
rows.user_action: 数量超上限——核 exchangeInfo lot 规则

rows.name: EQUITY_QTY_LOT_STEP
rows.user_action: 数量非 lot 步长整数倍——取整链缺陷，报修

rows.name: EQUITY_NOTIONAL_BELOW_MIN
rows.user_action: 金额低于最小名义额（$1 起）——加大或合并

rows.name: EQUITY_NOTIONAL_ABOVE_MAX
rows.user_action: 金额超上限——拆单

rows.name: EQUITY_PRICE_ABOVE_RANGE
rows.user_action: 限价超允许区间——核对现价

rows.name: EQUITY_PRICE_BELOW_RANGE
rows.user_action: 限价低于允许区间——核对现价

rows.name: EQUITY_TOO_MANY_OPEN_ORDERS
rows.user_action: 在途单达上限——等待清账后自动重试

rows.name: EQUITY_BUY_FORBIDDEN
rows.user_action: 该票禁买——标黑当轮

rows.name: EQUITY_SELL_FORBIDDEN
rows.user_action: 该票禁卖——等待状态恢复

rows.name: EQUITY_HALTED
rows.user_action: 停牌中——等复牌（tradingStatus 流驱动）

rows.name: EQUITY_NOTIONAL_MAX
rows.user_action: 名义额超票级上限——拆单

rows.name: EQUITY_SELL_ONLY
rows.user_action: 账户仅可卖（资格/保证金）——拒买+告警

rows.name: EQUITY_PDT_RESTRICTION
rows.user_action: PDT 保证金保护——拒买+告警，人工入金或等平仓

rows.name: EQUITY_PREMARKET_LIMIT_ONLY
rows.user_action: 盘前仅限价单——市价单改限价

rows.name: EQUITY_ODD_LOT_MARKET_ONLY
rows.user_action: 碎股仅市价单——碎股 LIMIT 改 MARKET 或整股

rows.name: EQUITY_TYPE_NO_ODD_LOT
rows.user_action: 该单型不支持碎股——改单型

rows.name: EQUITY_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID
rows.user_action: 重复 clientOrderId——查 order/detail 回填真实单号
